_comment: 推荐优先级体系：硬阻断 > 实用 > 美观 > 舒适。每层级得分影响单品在推荐中的权重。

hard_blocks._comment: 不通过直接淘汰，不参与后续评分

rules.desc: 气温≥30°C时禁止厚外套/羊毛/灯芯绒
rules.check: weather_temp >= 30 and ('羊毛' in fabric_primary or '皮质' in fabric_primary or '灯芯绒' in fabric_primary) and cat_code == 'JK'

rules.desc: 气温≤10°C时禁止短裤/背心/凉鞋

rules.check: weather_cond in ('雨', '暴雨', '雷雨') and cat_code in ('SH', 'PT') and ('白' in hue_name or '米白' in hue_name or '浅' in hue_name)

rules.desc: 商务/正式场合禁止短裤
rules.check: occasion in ('商务', '正式') and cat_code == 'SH'

rules.desc: 运动场景禁止拖鞋/凉鞋
rules.check: occasion == '运动' and item.category_code == 'SHOE' and item.fabric.primary in ('塑料', 'EVA')

rules.desc: 禁止同品类出现两件（如两条裤子）

practical._comment: 实用层（权重0.4）：保证能穿、功能正确

rules.desc: 面料季节适配当日气温
上衣+下装+鞋子三件套齐全
场景功能匹配：运动→至少一件运动单品
rules.check: occasion == '运动' and any(item.category_code in ('TS','SH','SHOE') and item.fabric.primary in ('涤纶','速干') for item in outfit)

rules.desc: 高温晴天有帽子/墨镜加分
rules.check: weather_temp >= 30 and weather_cond == '晴' and any(item.category_code in ('HAT','SUN') for item in outfit)
weather_temp <= 15 and any(item.category_code in ('JK','LS') for item in outfit)

aesthetic._comment: 美观层（权重0.35）：颜色协调、风格统一、廓形平衡

rules.desc: 整体配色协调（无冲突撞色）
所有单品对目标风格得分 ≥ 30
上宽下窄或外松内紧的廓形平衡
rules.check: outfit_level: top宽松 + bottom修身 or 外宽松 + 内贴身
any('增加肩宽' in item.modifiers or '增加体量感' in item.modifiers for item in outfit)

comfort._comment: 舒适层（权重0.25）：面料亲肤、版型宽松、个人偏好

rules.check: '棉' in fabric_primary or '麻' in fabric_primary or '亚麻' in fabric_primary or '丝' in fabric_primary

rules.desc: 日常场景宽松版型加分
rules.check: item.silhouette.fit == '宽松' and occasion in ('日常','休闲')

rules.desc: 用户评分历史偏好加成
rules.check: item has been rated 3-star before in similar context
